reviews.text:
I have been taking my dogs to Victoria at Knot to Shaggy for 11 years, with a number of different dogs over that time. Some were easy and some were not so easy, but she always took care of their needs. Today she grooms my two dogs, Frankie and Iris, and does an excellent job with them. They always come home clean, happy and looking their best.

At one point I asked to have my Aussie shaved because I had seen it often and thought it looked cute. Victoria took the time to explain why she would not shave a double coated breed and how harmful it can be for them. I appreciated her honesty and that she put my dog's wellbeing first. That is exactly the kind of groomer you want.

I am so grateful to Victoria for the care she gives Frankie and Iris, and I wouldn't trust anyone else with them.
Knot 2 Shaggy is great!!!!  Austin does such a great job and takes good care of my lil buddy Roscoe.  Just look at that smile. 😎

Whoever does the grooming of the cats DOES NOT WASH THEIR TOOLS! do NOT come here! immediately after i took my cat to them, she had ringworm! this has cost me $900 and COUNTING because we have still not rid ourselves of it. i am infuriated every time i think of this place.

We took our boy Charlie today for a groom. They did exceptional! He had been shedding tufts and they brushed him out nicely, clipped nails nice and short and he smells amazing! Best grooming experience I have had.
Love it thank you again  and again Lola loves yall 💖 …

I have been taking my dog Simon here for 2 years now. I just got a second dog named Betty. I love how my dogs look and their groomer is Victoria. She does an excellent job grooming them! The services they offer are excellent and the pricing is also excellent. In addition to my dogs monthly grooming, I also upgrade my dogs to the hydrotherapy bath which is so good for a deep exfoliation of their skin.
Thank you Victoria and Austin for being so helpful and for taking good care of my precious fur babies!
My cairn terrier looks AMAZING! Victoria is an artist :)
Great customer service , friendly staff ! Thanks again!

They now charge a deposit to do your dogs if you haven't been there in a while( 6 to 8 weeks she said) .  When I was discussing it with the owner she hung up in my face.  We have used their services for several years.  This is not how you treat a customer who has spent lots of money with you.  We have 2 dogs.
Austin is the best. Our girl Charlotte loves going to see him and get groomed. No matter what shape her hair is in, he knows just how to fix it!

Katherine was amazing with Coco. Left her so adorable, perfect for her 10th birthday! Thank you guys so much on short notice. Everything about the experience was really great. I will say it’s a bit pricey at $100, considering I pay $70 at my veterinarian Groomer. I understand different groomers charge differently. I am a happy customer. Will be returning on special occasions. Thank you guys. Highly recommend Katherine. Made our first time a very good one.

Excellent customer service and definitely worth every penny! If you have a pet, please do your research BEFORE attaining such pet! Factor in groom cost bc it will be part of their well being! If you complain about groomers and their pricing, then don’t get a dog plain and simple!
Extremely overrated —their price for what u receive is extreme—double from 2 years ago—I would never recommend them to anyone—will never go there again—total ripoff
